chunks: 5322 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Nu'aym ibn Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who killed the fetus of a female slave belonging to a group of people while it was in her womb, he عليه السلام said: “If it died in her womb after he struck her, then half of one-tenth of the value of the female slave is upon him. And if he struck her and she cast it out alive, then it died, then one-tenth of the value of the female slave is upon him.”

key_terms.جَنِينِ أَمَةٍ: the fetus of a female slave
key_terms.عُشْرَ قِيمَةِ الْأَمَةِ: one-tenth of the female slave’s value
key_terms.فَأَلْقَتْهُ حَيًّا: she miscarried or delivered it alive
key_terms.نِصْفُ عُشْرِ قِيمَةِ الْأَمَةِ: half of one-tenth of the female slave’s value

ai.seo_question: What compensation is due for killing the fetus of a female slave in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the blood money owed for causing the death of the fetus of a female slave. It distinguishes between the case where the fetus dies in the womb after the ضرب and the case where it is delivered alive and then dies, assigning a different proportion of the slave-woman’s value in each case.
